review.headline: Easy 9 km completed on target distance at 5:42/km, inside the 5:11-6:13 easy band.
observations: Distance 8.99 km against a planned 9.0 km, with no pace or HR drift across the nine splits (all 5:42/km).
Average HR 138 with a max of 141 indicates genuinely easy effort, consistent with the conversational intent.
Easy pace sits about 30 s/km slower than the 5:11 lower bound, so the run was controlled rather than fast.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so subjective effort is unknown.
Training metrics show CTL falling from 43 to 26.7 with no sessions logged after 5 Nov, so the athlete has largely stopped running.
